title: Valorant Clutch
blurb: Last player alive, outnumbered, and somehow the round is still winnable. Clutching in Valorant means taking a situation everybody has already written off and dragging it back, and the game marks it with a sting sharp enough to be worth the screenshot. Teammates in the spectator chat lose their minds. The clip works outside the game for any solo rescue of a group project — it carries an edge of disbelief that a plain victory fanfare never manages. Riot understands that the near-loss is what makes it taste good.
